title: Barnes and his saxophonists doubling on clarinet
summary: Allen and Reason discuss Samuel Johnson as Barnes's understudy and Barnes playing clarinet and later soprano.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: I see. Before I forget it, too, another thing. You mentioned Samuel Johnson playing sax with Paul.
And what did he play? What kind of... Alto sax. He played... You had Paul on alto and him on alto? Yes. I see. I just...
He was an understudy of Paul. Yeah.
And Gene Porter was playing what kind of sax? Yeah. Did... Were those guys ever played clarinet?
Would you? Yes. Most all those fellas doubled on clarinet. Mm-hmm.
Yeah, I guess... That's so true. I was quite surprised to hear you say that you had Paul playing clarinet.
To get the Fats of Alma sound.
Because I always thought of him as... Alto player. Alto and soprano and... Well, he wasn't playing soprano.
No. He started playing soprano when he went to California. Yeah. When he moved out there.
